steps.heading: From a file to a DataFrame
steps.body: pd.read_csv(path) is the standard way real data enters pandas. By default it infers a header row, guesses each column's dtype, and assigns a plain integer index, often not exactly what you want.

steps.heading: The basic load

steps.caption: Always check .dtypes and .head() right after loading, inference can surprise you.

steps.heading: Controlling the load
steps.body: index_col, usecols, dtype, and parse_dates all shape the load itself, rather than fixing things up afterward. na_values tells pandas which placeholder strings (like '?') mean missing, not literal text.
